reviewed_run: Kaggle MLB production run for 20260930 (pushed as 5358010, 'Update MLB features + predictions: 2026-10-01 04:35'); ran on top of 6b3b3e2 'Shrink recent pitcher runs allowed toward prior history'.

run_health_summary.ingestion: 2,286,957 raw pitches full repull 2024-01-01→2026-09-30; 2,169,456 saved; 7,382 decided games; IL reconciliation clean (0 on-IL-while-betting player-games after reconcile, budget 250).
run_health_summary.walk: 82 fold slots (74 evaluated; 8 skipped <40 val games — MLB rule), pooled auc 0.5611 / brier 0.2456 / logloss 0.6843 / ece 0.0068; SHAP additivity verified for both boosting members.
run_health_summary.artifacts: todays_games_20260930.csv (4-game slate), predictions_history 6887 games, run_engine_oof 6887 rows, monitor 3 winner cards — all consistent.

findings.issue: Earned blend weights jumped xgboost 0.8% → 8.7% (elasticnet 53.9% → 42.2%, lightgbm 45.2% → 49.1%) vs the prior run.
findings.verdict: NO ACTION — mechanism working as designed
evidence: Rolling weights are re-earned by SLSQP (logit-space, pooled OOF log-loss) after every fold; the bundle carries the last fold's earned vector, which is a verdict over ALL 6,887 pooled OOF games — not a 91-game last-fold artifact.

The run included 6b3b3e2, which regularizes sp_era_5g (30 pseudo-IP shrink toward the pitcher's non-overlapping older history, league-prior cold-start fallback) — a substantive change to a feature family all three members consume, so member OOF predictions changed and the blend verdict legitimately re-earned.

Direction is consistent with the 2026-09-30 retune's seal verdict: xgboost tied for best log-loss (0.67580) and best ECE (0.0155) on the 8 sealed recent folds; recent-form evidence has favored xgboost.

Version history: xgboost held 100% of the blend v2026.09.24–09.28, 0% on v09.29, 8.7% on v09.30/10.01 — the SLSQP verdict is frame-sensitive and moves with feature changes, as designed (no floor/cap per the 2026-09-21 no-gates adoption).

findings.issue: Blend-level calibrated metrics WORSE than raw for the second consecutive run (v2026.09.29: ECE 0.0046→0.0052, ll 0.6844→0.6849; v2026.09.30: ECE 0.0068→0.0088, ll 0.6843→0.6847, brier 0.2456→0.2458) — yet the fitted favored-space Platt map (a=1.107, b=-0.023, floor 0.5) was still shipped ungated and applied to published probabilities.

remediation.change: calibration.should_gate_calibrator (pure decision fn) + wiring in training.walk_forward_evaluate: when the honest PREQUENTIAL calibrated column (fit-on-prior-folds only) is worse than the raw blend on BOTH log-loss and ECE, the bundle ships the identity map (raw blend) instead of the harmful correction; mixed evidence keeps the fitted map; self-reversing run over run.
remediation.causality: Gate input is the prequential column — each point corrected only by a map fitted on strictly prior folds, identical to how the deployed map behaves on unseen games. No new calibration layer is introduced (member-level layer search remains NOT ADOPTED, mlb_tune_calibration_2026-09-30.json).
remediation.context: Generalizes the 2026-08-27 flip-test status quo (DON'T ADOPT identity, platt helped then: ECE 0.0047 vs 0.0096) into a per-run causal rule; calibration helped through v2026.09.28 (e.g. v09.27 ECE 0.0059→0.0027) and the gate would have passed it then and withheld it on v09.29/v09.30.
remediation.degenerate_warnings: The 3 'degenerate Platt params (a<0) — identity map' warnings (folds 5, 6, run-engine final fit) are the existing correct fallback (a<=0 would invert ranking) and are unrelated to the moneyline map, which fit fine (a=1.107); run-engine (NB markets) calibration untouched by contract.
remediation.tests: mlb-backend/backend/test_calibration_gate.py (8 tests: fires on unambiguous harm incl. tiny margins; keeps map on benefit/mixed/ties; never fires on missing/non-finite inputs). Battery 183 passed; check_production_graph OK.

findings.issue: WARNING Feature coverage gaps: exp2_cat_k_offspeed_diff & exp2_cat_xwoba_offspeed_diff 57% current vs 64% baseline; wind_advantage_flyball_factor 73% baseline.
findings.verdict: NO ACTION — monitored, known seasonal/observational gaps
evidence: Offspeed coverage tracks pitch-type sparsity in recent windows; the drift monitor itself scored 0 warnings / 0 alerts / 2 seasonal on noise-adjusted PSI — the gaps are coverage, not distribution drift.

Both columns stay in the active 101-feature subset; members already impute missing values per-fold (train-median), so low coverage degrades gracefully. Removing features would be a subset change requiring its own gate; nothing here justifies it.
Wind coverage is bounded by Open-Meteo observation availability (7376/7382 history games; 3/4 slate games) — already loudly reported, NULL-stays-NULL semantics.

findings.issue: SP slate staleness gate: 145 pitchers enter 2026-09-30 off a >=10d availability-stint gap; announced starters among them have carried SP lines withheld.
evidence: Late-September rosters legitimately contain many expanded-roster/callup/injured arms with 10+ day gaps; 145 flags league-wide is expected, and only announced starters among them are affected on the 4-game slate.
Withholding pre-stint carried form is the 2026-09-30 no-new-features decision (stronger NULL semantics); shrinkage of sp_era_5g (6b3b3e2) is a separate, complementary regularizer.
